nodes.summary: For natural numbers $d$ and $N$, the integer box $[0, N)^d$ is the finite set of vectors $v \in \mathbb{Z}^d$ with $0 \le v_i < N$ for every coordinate $i$.
nodes.title: Integer box

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on a measurable space $\Omega$. A map $T : \Omega \to \Omega$ is aperiodic with respect to $\mu$ if the set of periodic points of $T$, the points $x$ with $T^k(x) = x$ for some $k \ge 1$, where $T^k$ is the $k$-fold iterate of $T$, has (outer) $\mu$-measure zero. Equivalently, for $\mu$-almost every $x$, no positive iterate of $T$ fixes $x$.
nodes.title: Aperiodic transformation

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $\mu$ be a measure on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $T$ assign to each $v \in \mathbb{Z}^d$ a map $T_v \colon \Omega \to \Omega$. Then $T$ is free (in the Ornstein–Weiss sense) with respect to $\mu$ if, for every nonzero $v \in \mathbb{Z}^d$, the set of points $x \in \Omega$ with $T_v(x) = x$ has $\mu$-measure zero.
nodes.title: Free $\mathbb{Z}^d$-action

nodes.summary: Let $\Omega$ be a measurable space, $T : \Omega \to \Omega$ a map and $n \in \mathbb{N}$. A set $B \subseteq \Omega$ is the base of a Rokhlin tower of height $n$ for $T$ if $B$ is measurable and the floors $B, T(B), \dots, T^{n-1}(B)$ are pairwise disjoint, that is, $T^i(B) \cap T^j(B) = \emptyset$ for all $i \ne j$ with $i, j < n$; here $T^k(B)$ is the image of $B$ under the $k$-fold iterate of $T$.
nodes.title: Rokhlin tower

nodes.summary: Let $d \ge 1$, let $\Omega$ be a standard Borel space with a probability measure $\mu$, and let $T$ assign to each $v \in \mathbb{Z}^d$ a map $T_v \colon \Omega \to \Omega$ such that $T_0$ is the identity, $T_{u + v} = T_u \circ T_v$ for all $u, v \in \mathbb{Z}^d$, every $T_v$ is measure preserving for $\mu$, and the action is free (for every $v \ne 0$ the set of fixed points of $T_v$ has $\mu$-measure zero). Then…
nodes.title: Ornstein–Weiss Rokhlin lemma for $\mathbb{Z}^d$-actions

nodes.summary: Let $\Omega$ be a standard Borel space with a probability measure $\mu$, and let $T : \Omega \to \Omega$ be a measure-preserving map that is aperiodic with respect to $\mu$. Then for every integer $n \ge 1$ and every $\varepsilon \in (0, \infty]$ there is a measurable set $B \subseteq \Omega$ such that the floors $B, T(B), \dots, T^{n-1}(B)$ are pairwise disjoint, where $T^k(B)$ is the image of $B$ under the…
nodes.title: Rokhlin lemma for non-invertible maps

nodes.summary: For a map $T : \Omega \to \Omega$, a set $B \subseteq \Omega$ and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the level-$k$ floor with base $B$ is the image $T^k(B)$ of $B$ under the $k$-fold iterate $T^k$ of $T$; the level-$0$ floor is $B$.
nodes.title: Floor of a Rokhlin tower

nodes.summary: For a map $T : \Omega \to \Omega$, a set $B \subseteq \Omega$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the union of the tower with base $B$ and height $n$ is the set $\bigcup_{k=0}^{n-1} T^k(B)$ of its floors $B, T(B), \dots, T^{n-1}(B)$, where $T^k(B)$ is the image of $B$ under the $k$-fold iterate of $T$. It is empty when $n = 0$, and no disjointness of the floors is required.
nodes.title: Union of a Rokhlin tower

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
